fields.climate: tropical; semiarid where mountains in east cut off trade winds
fields.hazards: lies in the middle of the hurricane belt and subject to severe storms from June to October; occasional flooding and earthquakes; periodic droughts
fields.resources: bauxite, copper, calcium carbonate, gold, marble, hydropower, arable land
fields.farm: sugarcane, cassava, plantains, bananas, mangoes/guavas, avocados, maize, tropical fruits, rice, vegetables
fields.exports: garments, essential oils, scrap iron, industrial acids/oils/alcohols, bedding
fields.industries: textiles, sugar refining, flour milling, cement, light assembly using imported parts
fields.legal: civil law system strongly influenced by Napoleonic Code
fields.military: men and women 18-25 may volunteer for the FAdH
